L5.source: sealed experiment b289e536, same reviewed protocol family, same rig

finding: Adding this 5th L2 run (n now 30 cycles) does not change the sibling experiment's conclusion and tightens it: L2 pools to -0.449 deg against L5's -0.832, a ratio of about 0.54, and the two per-cycle distributions still do not overlap -- L2's single most extreme cycle (-0.615) is still short of L5's least extreme (-0.703). The loaded-vs-unloaded settled-angle offset is a per-joint mechanical property, so a single global backlash constant in the walk controller would mis-compensate both legs.
